text: 创业板指涨超1%，沪指涨0.17%，深成指涨0.73%，玻璃基板、创新药、液冷服务器、半导体等方向领涨，沪深京三市上涨个股近2600只
text_en: ChiNext Index rises over 1%, Shanghai Composite rises 0.17%, Shenzhen Component rises 0.73%, with glass substrates, innovative drugs, liquid cooling servers, semiconductors and other sectors leading gains; nearly 2,600 stocks rose across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
